 Cougars-Mountaineers Kickoff, Network Announced
 11/15/2026 10:10:00 AM | Football
 Share: Houston, West Virginia slated for Noon CT kick on TNT
 HOUSTON – The #14 Houston Football team wraps up its road slate with a Noon CT kickoff on TNT at West Virginia on Saturday, Nov. 21.
Houston (7-3, 4-3 Big 12) enters the final two weeks of the season ranked in the Top 25 for the 11th consecutive poll – the longest stretch to begin a season since 1990.
West Virginia (5-5, 2-5 Big 12) is coming off a 37-14 loss to Kansas on Saturday, Nov. 14. The Cougars are the Mountaineers' Senior Day opponent before traveling to Utah for their regular season finale.
The AP Poll will be released on Monday at 1 p.m. CT due to scheduling changes from Friday's FAA nationwide ground stop which impacted college football team travel, along with travelers across the country.
